div.head: III Eg 2
div.ab: ⁊ ne gesece nán man þone cyng for nanre spræce, butan he æt ham rihtes wyrðe beon ne mote oððe riht abiddan ne mæge.
⁊ na gesece nan man þæne cing for nanre spæce, butan he æt ham rihtes wyrþe beon ne móte oððe riht abiddan ne mæge.
Et nemo requirat regem pro aliqua causa, nisi domi negetur ei omne dignum recti uel rectum impetrare non possit.
[Be ðone ðe mon cyng gesece ⁊ be ðæm were.] [Ld] ⁊ ne gesece nan man þone cyngc for nanre spræce, buton he æt ham rihtes [wyrðe] beon ne mote, oððe riht abiddan ne mæg.
And ne gesece nan man þone cyng for nanre spræce butan he æt ham rihtes wyrðe beon ne mote oððe riht abiddan ne mæge.
And no one shall apply to the king about any case, unless he cannot obtain the benefit of the law or fails to command justice at home.
And no one may petition the king concerning a lawsuit unless he cannot obtain his rights at home and cannot appeal to another court.
And no one is to apply to the king in any suit, unless he may not be entitled to right or cannot obtain justice at home.

(Davon, dass jemand den König angeht. Und vom Wergeld. Ld) Und niemand gehe den König an wegen einer Klagesache, ausser wenn er daheim [seines] Rechtes nicht theilhaftig werden kann oder Recht zu erlangen nicht vermag.
(Of applying to the king. And of wergild. Ld) And let no one apply to the king in any suit unless he cannot obtain [his] right at home or cannot get justice.
